title: Uncle Matt: missiles disabled at Malmstrom all the time

tellings.quote: happens all the time. These things would happen and disable the nuclear weapons.

plain: Kevin Knuth, a physicist and former NASA scientist, passes on what his uncle Matt told him about Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base that holds nuclear missiles, in the early 1970s. According to Knuth, his uncle said it happened all the time: these things would show up and disable the nuclear weapons. If true, it would mean something unknown could repeatedly switch off US nuclear missiles.
